newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-MoDo Q1 pretax seen down 61 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-MoDo Q1 pretax seen down 61 pct.

text.p: Swedish forestry group MoDo AB is expected to post a 61 percent drop in pre-tax profit to 332 million crowns for the first quarter of 1997, a Reuter survey of 13 analysts showed.
Forecasts ranged from 100 million crowns to 465 million.
In the corresponding period last year, pre-tax profit was 858 million crowns.
For the full-year 1997, analysts expect an average profit of 1.71 billion crowns and earnings per share of 13.10 crowns.
MoDo is to release first quarter earnings on April 29.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Aros, Carnegie, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, Norske Bank, Paribas, Penser, Salomon Brothers, Societe Generale and Swedbank. ----------------------------------------------------------
